tagline.en: A small n8n-style workflow builder made with React + React Flow.
tagline.pt: Um construtor de fluxos de trabalho, no estilo n8n, criado com React + React Flow.

description.en:
A small n8n-style workflow builder made with React + React Flow. Build a flow by connecting nodes, click Run, and each node receives the previous node's output as `input`.

Open http://localhost:5173.
description.pt:
Um pequeno construtor de fluxos de trabalho no estilo n8n, feito com React + React Flow. Crie um fluxo conectando nós, clique em Executar e cada nó receberá a saída do nó anterior como `entrada`.

Abra http://localhost:5173.
